'''Julián Rebolledo''' (born 1972) is an American actor and voice actor for the English dub of {{aniseries|PTS}}. He is sometimes credited as "'''Julian Dean'''".

==Biography==
Rebolledo became an actor and voice actor as an adult. He voiced characters during {{aniseries|DP}} of the {{pkmn|animated series}}, with the most notable role being that of Paul. In his personal life, he co-owns the New York City dubbing studio Hyperbolic Audio with [[Sean Reyes]]. In addition, Rebolledo has provided voice-overs for many television shows and commercials, and has also done some on-camera roles.
